notes: Wikidata publishes weekly entity dumps through Wikimedia. The recommended starting point is the latest-all JSON dump, which is line-delimited, suitable for offline parsing, and now acquired as a gzipped artefact; RDF truthy and full statement dumps remain follow-up options if company extraction needs graph joins or richer statement context. Promoted from research_required on 2026-08-26: acquire/shard/canonical are proven in production (resumable equivalence-tested Rust extractor, chunked resume, name-variant sidecar), and cleanse/tokenize have since been run against Wikidata output too. Promoted from supported to live on 2026-09-02 alongside being flagged into '--systems all': a landed extractor and cleansed data are what that flag is for, and excluding it meant a regeneration silently skipped a real source.

resources.name: wikidata_entities_latest_all
resources.notes: Weekly Wikidata entity dump recommended by the Wikidata database download documentation; the source file is a line-delimited JSON dump compressed as gzipped JSONL for direct projection and sharding.
